Cooley, Gordon, and Sengun had no new negative news (Gordon and Sengun not repriced to save credits). There is one leg per game, no morning players, and no shared game thesis. Per-book multiplicative devig at the exact line, median across 3-6 books. Cooldown check is clean (none of these players missed this prop Nov 15-17). No college props. Washington U1.5 ast (only 2 books at -185/-197, so it needs volume work), and De'Andre Hunter U1.5 ast (DTD history). Odds API usage: 20 credits this run, 441 left. Confirm each line on the app, since book lines are assumed to equal the PP/UD lines.
